title: Name who may use the Entra Policy Suite web app (the first SuperAdmin)
purpose: Names a SuperAdmin of the web app when there is none: it starts the install's database setup job with that person, which writes the access list and the audit trail. A SuperAdmin then manages access in the app (Admin and Reader are given there). An install made before 2.0.59 is written directly (any role).
whenToRun: Once after the install, or when no SuperAdmin is left.

runAs.name: Contributor (or any role that may start a Container Apps job)
runAs.why: starts the database setup job, which names the SuperAdmin when there is none - no database right needed (installs made since 2.0.59)

runAs.name: the Entra Policy Suite SQL server's Entra admin - only for an install made before 2.0.59 (no database setup job)
any user who can read users (Directory Readers is enough)
runAs.why: checks the person exists and pins their object id

changes.why: who may use the web app
changes.undo: remove the person in the app's Access page (a SuperAdmin), or run again with -Role Reader
not possible: the audit trail is append-only

parameters.name: SubscriptionId
parameters.help: the subscription Entra Policy Suite is installed in

parameters.name: ResourceGroup
parameters.help: the install's resource group (an install made before 2.0.55: rg-entrapolicysuite, found by itself when it is there)

readsOnly: Graph: the signed-in user and the named user (id, UPN)
whatIf: The person, the role and who grants it; nothing is changed.
undo: A SuperAdmin removes the person on the app's Access page.
